title: Dragging a brush/vector shape shows no live preview during the move (only commits on mouse-up)
description: FIXED (commit pending). Root cause: split-on-move (subSplitDragRef) committed onSubSplitMove ONLY on mouse-up; no per-move render, so the dragged face stayed at origin and jumped on release (the live selectionDragRef path was no longer reached once partialSelectEnabled became always-on for the Selection tool, P5 cutover). Fix (render-only, StageArea.tsx): on first move past the 3px threshold run splitOnMove(ps,keys,0,0) ONCE to extract {remainder,extracted} (cached in a ref); each subsequent move TRANSLATES the extracted geometry by the live offset (scene-graph swaps target->remainder@base + extracted@(base+dx,dy); halo follows). No per-move planar recompute (relies on split-at-0-then-translate==split-with-delta). Doc untouched mid-drag; Shell.handleSubSplitMove still commits the authoritative split once on mouse-up (one pushDoc/undo, geometry identical). Sub-threshold click only selects. EVIDENCE: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build PASS; authoring-ui 1022/1022 PASS; core planar-subselection 15/15 PASS (incl new extract-at-0-then-translate==split-with-delta, rect+curve); merge-drawing-oracle 8/8 diff=0/220000; pointer-stage-1275 7/7 PASS (selection drag commits, no snap-back); NEW e2e drag-live-preview-1331.spec.ts 3/3 PASS (rect+oval mid-drag preview follows cursor; click-no-move). 3 pre-existing core fla failures are missing untracked fixture flash8-empty.fla (task-1207 class, unrelated). Bridge gained __flashTest.setFillColor/setStrokeNone. Docs/36 §3.0b updated.
